app.name: OpenAMBike
app.disclaimer: Unofficial, open-source companion app for Ampler e-bikes. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ampler Bikes OÜ.
common.commandFailed: The bike did not take the command: {error}
home.bluetoothMissing: This browser has no Bluetooth. Use Chrome or Edge, or the Android app.
home.keyInvalid: The owner key is 28 characters, with no spaces.
home.keyNotSaved: Connected, but the key could not be saved on this device.
dashboard.title: Bike
assist.title: Assist
battery.title: Battery
more.title: Settings
more.restartConfirm: The bike restarts its firmware and disconnects; it keeps its settings. Connect again afterwards.
more.sleepConfirm: The bike turns off all its electronics, GPS and mobile network included. Only attaching the charger turns it on again.
more.calibrateConfirm: The bike recalibrates its torque sensor's signal, which can improve how it responds to pedalling.
more.exportHelp: An encrypted copy of the key, to keep as a backup or to use on another device. Choose a passphrase of at least 8 characters; without it the copy cannot be opened.
more.passphraseShort: The passphrase is at least 8 characters.
more.exportReady: Copy this text and keep it somewhere safe, such as a password manager.
more.importHelp: Paste an exported key and type its passphrase. It replaces the key saved on this device.
more.imported: The key is saved on this device.
more.importFailed: Wrong passphrase, or not an exported key.
more.forget: Forget the key on this device
more.forgetConfirm: The key is removed from this device. Make sure you have it elsewhere, or you will not be able to connect.
home.tagline: Your e-bike, over Bluetooth, with no account or server.
more.forgotten: The key was removed from this device.
home.keyGuide: How do I get my key?
home.reportReading: Looking for the key in the bug report…
home.reportUnreadable: This file is not a bug report the app can read. Choose the .zip that "Take bug report" made.
home.reportNoLog: No Bluetooth log in this bug report. Turn on "Bluetooth HCI snoop log", turn Bluetooth off and on, connect with the official app, then take the bug report again.
home.reportNoConnection: The bug report does not show the official app connecting to the bike. Connect with the official app after turning on the snoop log, set to "Enabled", then take the bug report again.
home.reportNoKey: The bike accepted no key in this bug report. Connect with the official app again and take a new bug report.
home.reportChoose: The bug report holds more than one bike or owner. Only the right key is accepted; try another if the bike refuses it.
home.reportFound: Key read from the bug report. Connect to check it, then delete the bug report: it holds the key and other private data.
error.refused: The bike did not accept the key.
error.bluetoothOff: Bluetooth is off. Turn it on and try again.
error.permission: The app may not use Bluetooth. Allow it in the phone's settings.
error.timeout: The bike did not answer. Is it on and nearby?
error.notFound: The bike was not found. Is it on and nearby?
error.lost: The connection with the bike was lost.
error.notConfirmed: It did not confirm the change, and it is as it was.
home.noneFound: No bike found. Is it on and nearby?
home.otherKeyConfirm: The saved key is removed from this device, so that you can type another. Make sure you have it elsewhere.
home.asleep: The bike is asleep. Attach the charger to wake it.
more.licencesIntro: OpenAMBike and the libraries it is built with, each with its licence.
battery.healthNote: Capacity and health are estimates from the energy left and the charge, shown above {min} % charge. Health compares the capacity with the rated capacity.
battery.ratedMessage: Every Ampler model known is rated for {wh} Wh. Change it only if your battery's rating differs, such as a replacement battery's.
battery.ratedInvalid: Type a whole number from {min} to {max} Wh.
signal.title: Signal test
signal.note: Your bike shows here only while no app is connected to it. Nothing is sent to the bike.
more.autoConnectInfo: Connects to your bike when you are next to it, even with the app closed, and disconnects when you walk away. A notification shows while it is on.
more.autoLockInfo: Locks your bike when you walk away from it. Never while it moves.
autoConnect.mayBeUnlocked: Connection lost before locking. Your bike may be unlocked.
autoConnect.pausedParkedLocked: Locked and paused after {minutes} min parked
more.autoUnlockInfo: Unlocks your bike whenever your phone comes within about 1.5 m, even if you do not mean to ride. If you lock it in the app, it stays locked until you unlock it there.
more.autoRideInfo: Records a ride once your bike has moved for 20 seconds, and stops it when you walk away or after 15 minutes standing.
more.autoRideLocationOff: Auto-ride is on, but rides it starts with the app closed have no route without it.
more.autoRideRestored: Auto-ride is back on from your backup. To give the rides it starts with the app closed their route, allow location all the time.
more.needsApp: Only available in the Android app.
more.autoUnlockConfirm: Your bike will unlock whenever your phone comes within about 1.5 m of it, whether you mean to ride or not, as with the bike parked beside your home. Turn auto-unlock on?
home.autoConnectPaused: Disconnected. Auto-connect is paused until you connect again.
rides.title: Rides
rides.stopConfirm: The ride is kept in the history.
rides.noRoute: No route: the phone’s location was off or not allowed while this ride was recorded.
rides.deleteConfirm: The ride is removed from this phone.
more.autoConnectNeedsBike: Connect to your bike once first, so that auto-connect knows it.
